records.name: Pier A Gates (A1–A12)
records.description: Boarding gates A1 to A12 in Pier A of Terminal 1.
records.directions: After security North or South, follow signs for Gates A across the Airside Plaza; Pier A is on the left. Walking time from security is about 5 minutes.
records.availability_note: Individual gates open per departure; gate allocation is shown on departure boards only.

accessibility.notes: Level access throughout Pier A.

records.retrieval_text: Boarding gates A1 to A12, Pier A, airside Terminal 1, reached through security.

records.name: Pier B Gates (B1–B18)
records.description: Boarding gates B1 to B18 in Pier B of Terminal 1.
records.directions: After security North or South, follow signs for Gates B; Pier B is on the right past the Aurora Lounge. Walking time from security is about 7 minutes.
records.availability_note: Individual gates open per departure; gate allocation is shown on departure boards only.

accessibility.notes: Level access throughout Pier B.

records.retrieval_text: Boarding gates B1 to B18, Pier B, airside Terminal 1, beyond the Aurora Lounge.

records.name: Pier C Gates (C1–C10)
records.description: Boarding gates C1 to C10 in Pier C of Terminal 2.
records.directions: After Terminal 2 security, Pier C begins directly ahead. All gates are within 4 minutes' walk.
records.availability_note: Individual gates open per departure; gate allocation is shown on departure boards only.

accessibility.notes: Single-level pier.

records.retrieval_text: Boarding gates C1 to C10, Pier C, Terminal 2, directly after Terminal 2 security.

records.name: Check-in Hall, Terminal 1 (Desks 101–160)
records.description: Terminal 1 check-in hall with desks 101 to 160. Desk allocation by airline is shown on the hall displays.
records.directions: Enter Terminal 1 at Departures level; the Check-in Hall occupies the centre of the level. From Arrivals, take the lifts or escalators up one level.
records.availability_note: Desks open per flight schedule, typically 3 hours before departure.

accessibility.notes: Lowered counters at desks 101-104.

records.retrieval_text: Check-in desks 101 to 160 for departing passengers, Departures level, Terminal 1.

records.name: Check-in, Terminal 2 (Desks 201–230)
records.description: Terminal 2 check-in area with desks 201 to 230.
records.directions: Enter Terminal 2; check-in desks are immediately inside the entrance on the Departures level.
records.availability_note: Desks open per flight schedule.

accessibility.notes: Lowered counter at desk 201.

records.retrieval_text: Check-in desks 201 to 230 for departing passengers, Terminal 2 entrance level.

records.name: Security North, Terminal 1
records.description: Northern security checkpoint of Terminal 1, serving all airside areas.
records.directions: At the north end of the Check-in Hall, past desks 101-120.
records.availability_note: Live queue times are not available from this assistant; check terminal displays.

accessibility.notes: Dedicated assistance lane on request at the PRM point.

records.retrieval_text: Security screening checkpoint, north end of the Terminal 1 check-in hall.

records.name: Security South, Terminal 1
records.description: Southern security checkpoint of Terminal 1, serving all airside areas.
records.directions: At the south end of the Check-in Hall, past desks 141-160.
records.availability_note: Opens later and closes earlier than Security North; live queue times not available here.
records.retrieval_text: Security screening checkpoint, south end of the Terminal 1 check-in hall.

records.name: Security, Terminal 2
records.description: The single security checkpoint of Terminal 2.
records.directions: Behind the Terminal 2 check-in desks; follow the overhead signs.
records.availability_note: Live queue times are not available from this assistant.
records.retrieval_text: Security screening checkpoint of Terminal 2, behind the check-in desks.

records.name: Baggage Reclaim, Terminal 1 (Belts 1–6)
records.description: Arriving baggage is delivered on belts 1 to 6 in the Terminal 1 Arrivals Hall.
records.directions: From arriving flights, follow the baggage reclaim signs down to Level 0; belt allocation appears on the arrivals displays.
records.availability_note: Belt allocation per flight is shown on arrivals displays only.

accessibility.notes: Porter service on request at the PRM point.

records.retrieval_text: Baggage reclaim belts 1 to 6 where arriving passengers collect checked luggage, Arrivals Hall, Terminal 1.

records.name: Baggage Reclaim, Terminal 2 (Belts 7–9)
records.description: Arriving baggage for Terminal 2 flights is delivered on belts 7 to 9.
records.directions: From arriving flights at Pier C, follow reclaim signs down to Level 0.
records.availability_note: Belt allocation per flight is shown on arrivals displays only.

accessibility.notes: Nearest accessible toilet is on the Departures level above.

records.retrieval_text: Baggage reclaim belts 7 to 9 for arriving Terminal 2 passengers collecting checked luggage.

records.name: Lost Property Office
records.description: Central office for items lost anywhere at the airport or left on board aircraft. Serves both terminals.
records.directions: Arrivals Hall, Terminal 1, beside the arrivals information desk. From Terminal 2, take the shuttle to Terminal 1.
records.availability_note: Items left on aircraft are registered here by handling agents, usually within 24 hours.
records.retrieval_text: Lost property office for reporting and recovering lost or forgotten items, including items left on the plane. Serves both terminals.

records.name: Information Desk, Terminal 1 Arrivals
records.description: Staffed information desk in the Terminal 1 Arrivals Hall.
records.directions: Centre of the Arrivals Hall, facing the exit doors.
records.retrieval_text: Staffed help and information point for arriving passengers, Arrivals Hall, Terminal 1.

records.name: Information Desk, Terminal 1 Departures
records.description: Staffed information desk in the Terminal 1 Check-in Hall.
records.directions: Centre of the Check-in Hall between desks 130 and 131.
records.retrieval_text: Staffed help and information point for departing passengers, Check-in Hall, Terminal 1.

records.name: Information Desk, Terminal 2
records.description: Staffed information desk of Terminal 2.
records.directions: Beside the Terminal 2 entrance, before check-in.
records.retrieval_text: Staffed help and information point, Terminal 2 entrance level.

records.name: Flight Information (Departure and Arrival Boards)
records.description: Live flight, gate and delay information is shown on the departure and arrival boards throughout both terminals and by the operating airline.
records.directions: Boards are located in every hall and pier.
records.availability_note: This assistant does not hold live flight data. For gate allocations, delays, boarding times and cancellations, use the boards or the airline's official channels.

accessibility.notes: Staff at any information desk will read board information on request.

records.retrieval_text: Live flight status, gate allocation, boarding and delay information source: departure and arrival boards and the operating airline.

records.name: Aurora Lounge
records.description: The airport's only lounge, airside in Terminal 1 near the entrance to Pier B. Pay-per-visit and eligible airline programmes.
records.directions: After security, cross the Airside Plaza towards Gates B; the lounge entrance is on the upper mezzanine, lift available.
records.availability_note: Terminal 2 has no lounge; Terminal 2 passengers cannot access the Aurora Lounge after passing Terminal 2 security.

accessibility.notes: Lift to the mezzanine beside the stairs.

records.retrieval_text: Aurora Lounge: paid airport lounge with seating, refreshments and workspaces, airside Terminal 1 near Pier B.

records.name: Skyline Restaurant
records.description: Full-service restaurant airside in Terminal 1 with hot meals and table service.
records.directions: In the Airside Plaza between Piers A and B, opposite the departure boards.
records.availability_note: Hot kitchen closes 21:00.

accessibility.notes: Menus available in large print on request.

records.retrieval_text: Skyline Restaurant: sit-down meals with table service, airside Terminal 1 between the piers.

records.name: Harbour Café
records.description: Landside café in the Terminal 1 Arrivals Hall serving coffee, snacks and light meals. Accessible without a boarding pass.
records.directions: Arrivals Hall, next to the exit towards the bus terminal.
records.retrieval_text: Harbour Café: coffee, snacks and light meals before security, Arrivals Hall, Terminal 1, no boarding pass needed.

records.name: Pier C Café
records.description: Café at the start of Pier C in Terminal 2, after security.
records.directions: Immediately after Terminal 2 security, on the right at the start of Pier C.
records.availability_note: The only catering in Terminal 2.
records.retrieval_text: Pier C Café: coffee and snacks after security in Terminal 2, the only food outlet in that terminal.

records.name: Restrooms, Terminal 1 Arrivals
records.description: Toilets in the Terminal 1 Arrivals Hall, including an accessible toilet and baby-change room.
records.directions: Behind the arrivals information desk, signposted from the reclaim exit.

accessibility.notes: Accessible toilet opened with a standard access key or by the information desk.

records.retrieval_text: Toilets with accessible toilet and baby change, Arrivals Hall, Terminal 1.

records.name: Restrooms, Terminal 1 Departures and Airside
records.zone: Check-in Hall; Airside Plaza; Piers A and B
records.description: Toilets in the Check-in Hall and at several airside locations, each with an accessible toilet.
records.directions: Check-in Hall: behind the departures information desk. Airside: at the Plaza and mid-way along each pier.
records.retrieval_text: Toilets with accessible facilities on the Departures level and airside areas of Terminal 1.

records.name: Restrooms, Terminal 2
records.description: Toilets in Terminal 2, landside near check-in and airside in Pier C, each including an accessible toilet.
records.directions: Landside: left of the information desk. Airside: mid-way along Pier C.

accessibility.notes: The Arrivals level of Terminal 2 has no accessible toilet; use the Departures level.

records.retrieval_text: Toilets with accessible toilet in Terminal 2, near check-in and in Pier C.

records.name: Assistance Point, Terminal 1 Main Entrance
records.description: Designated point where passengers with disabilities or reduced mobility can announce arrival and request assistance, at the Terminal 1 main entrance.
records.directions: Immediately inside the main entrance doors, marked with the assistance symbol and a call button.

opening_hours.mon_sun: 04:00-23:00; call button answered at all times

records.availability_note: Pre-notification via the airline at least 48 hours before departure is recommended; assistance is provided without charge.

accessibility.notes: Seating, call button and induction loop at the point itself.

records.retrieval_text: Designated assistance point for passengers with reduced mobility to request help, Terminal 1 main entrance.

records.name: Assistance Point, Terminal 1 Check-in Hall
records.description: Designated assistance point in the Terminal 1 Check-in Hall for passengers with disabilities or reduced mobility.
records.directions: Beside desks 101-104 (lowered counters), marked with the assistance symbol.
records.availability_note: Escort through security and to the gate is arranged from this point.
records.retrieval_text: Designated assistance point for reduced-mobility passengers departing from Terminal 1, in the check-in hall.

records.name: Assistance Point, Terminal 2
records.description: Designated assistance point at the Terminal 2 entrance for passengers with disabilities or reduced mobility.
records.directions: Inside the Terminal 2 entrance, beside the information desk, marked with the assistance symbol and a call button.

opening_hours.mon_sun: 04:00-21:30; call button answered at all times

records.availability_note: Assistance provided without charge; pre-notification recommended.
records.retrieval_text: Designated assistance point for reduced-mobility passengers at the Terminal 2 entrance.

records.name: Assistance Point, Airport Rail Station
records.description: Designated assistance point at the entrance of Nordhaven Airport rail station, below Terminal 1.
records.directions: At the station entrance, before the lifts up to the Arrivals level, marked with the assistance symbol and a call button.

opening_hours.mon_sun: call button answered at all times

accessibility.notes: Nearest accessible toilet is in the Terminal 1 Arrivals Hall, one lift level up.

records.retrieval_text: Designated assistance point for reduced-mobility passengers at the airport rail station entrance.

records.name: Nordhaven Airport Rail Station
records.description: Rail station directly below Terminal 1 with trains to Nordhaven city centre and regional connections.
records.directions: From the Terminal 1 Arrivals Hall, take the lifts or escalators down one level, following the train symbol.
records.availability_note: City-centre trains roughly every 15 minutes; live times on station displays. Timetable data is synthetic and marked medium volatility.

accessibility.notes: Step-free lift access from Arrivals; staff assistance via the station assistance point.

records.retrieval_text: Airport rail station below Terminal 1 with trains to the city centre; reached by lift or escalator from Arrivals.

records.name: Bus Terminal
records.description: Local and regional bus departures from the forecourt outside Terminal 1 Arrivals.
records.directions: Exit the Arrivals Hall through the main doors; the bus terminal is directly ahead, stops 1-8.
records.availability_note: Route and time information on the stop displays; timetable data is synthetic.

accessibility.notes: Kerb-level boarding at stops 1 and 2.

records.retrieval_text: Bus terminal with local and regional buses on the forecourt outside Terminal 1 Arrivals.

records.name: Taxi Rank
records.description: Official taxi rank outside Terminal 1 Arrivals. The airport's only taxi rank; Terminal 2 passengers use the shuttle to Terminal 1.
records.directions: Exit the Arrivals Hall and turn right along the forecourt; the rank is signposted with the taxi symbol.

opening_hours.mon_sun: staffed marshal 06:00-23:00; taxis available at all times

records.availability_note: This assistant cannot book taxis; board at the rank or use the marshal.

accessibility.notes: Wheelchair-accessible vehicles requested via the marshal or the assistance line.

records.retrieval_text: Official taxi rank on the forecourt outside Terminal 1 Arrivals; wheelchair-accessible vehicles on request.

records.name: Car Park P1
records.description: Multi-storey car park opposite Terminal 1, connected by a covered footbridge to the Departures level.
records.directions: From Departures, cross the covered footbridge at the north end of the Check-in Hall. From Arrivals, take the lift to Level 1 first.
records.availability_note: Payment machines on the ground floor of P1.

accessibility.notes: Designated accessible bays on P1 ground floor near the lifts.

records.retrieval_text: Multi-storey car park P1 opposite Terminal 1, footbridge from the Departures level, accessible bays near the lifts.

records.name: Terminal Shuttle (T1 ↔ T2)
records.description: Free shuttle bus between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2, every 10 minutes.
records.directions: Terminal 1: forecourt stop 9, left of the main exit. Terminal 2: directly outside the entrance. Journey time about 6 minutes.
records.availability_note: Free of charge; step-free low-floor buses.

accessibility.notes: Low-floor boarding with ramp.

records.retrieval_text: Free shuttle bus connecting Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 every ten minutes, step-free boarding.

records.name: First Aid Room
records.description: Staffed first-aid room for medical assistance, beside Security North in Terminal 1. Serves both terminals; Terminal 2 incidents are attended by mobile staff.
records.directions: North end of the Check-in Hall, immediately beside the Security North entrance; marked with the first-aid symbol.

opening_hours.mon_sun: 04:00-23:00; out of hours call the assistance line

records.availability_note: In an emergency, alert any member of staff or use the assistance line; do not rely on this assistant for emergencies.
records.retrieval_text: First aid room for medical help and emergencies, beside Security North on the Terminal 1 Departures level.
